requirements.verbatim_text: Bids must be received by PS as prescribed no later than date and time specified in Section 1.3 (Schedule of Events).
You must submit your bid electronically by email to VendorProposals@twc.texas.gov.
Reference the IFB Title, IFB No., and the Submission Deadline date and time, in the subject line.
Hard copies received will not be accepted or reviewed.
Each Bidder is solely responsible for ensuring its Bid is submitted in accordance with all Solicitation requirements.
Each Bidder is solely responsible for ensuring timely receipt by TWC.
Bidder has completed, signed and submitted Form 1 – Execution of Bid in accordance with Section 6.1 Execution of Bid.
Bidder has completed and submitted Form 2 – Cost Sheet in accordance with Section 6.3 Cost Sheet.
Bidder who receives an overall score as recorded in the CPA Texas Vendor Performance Tracking System (VPTS) of “D” or below shall be disqualified from consideration for award.
TWC will consider the purchase price and whether the Bidder meets all requirements of this IFB.
Form 1 - Execution of Bid
Form 2- Cost Sheet
Public Information Act -, if applicable. Reference Section 3.12 Public Information Act – Bidder Requirements Regarding Disclosure
Form 3 TWC 1020 Substitute W-9 and Direct Deposit Form
Bidder must complete, sign, and return Form 1 – Execution of Bid.
By signing, Bidder agrees to provide the goods and/or services described in this Solicitation.
By signing, Bidder agrees to abide by all TWC Terms and Conditions as specified in this Solicitation and in any Contract resulting from an award.
Cost information must be included as a separate document.
Cost information must be presented only in the format set forth in Form 2 – Cost Sheet of this Solicitation.
Pricing agreed to in any resulting Contract shall be firm and remain constant through the life of the Contract.
